cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.

mechanism: A grades its former running pupil attention and repeatedly redefines A last-place finish as victory in route knowledge and memory.
confusable: Not merely finding a consolation: A keeps inviting a competitive comparison on newly favorable categories.
comparison: Observational race scoring versus practicality and modesty of trophies.
